sloka: न हि अयम् वैष्णवो दिव्यः शरः पर पुरंजयः ।मोघः पतति वीर्येण बल दर्प विनाशनः ॥१-७६-८॥
transliteration: na hi ayam vaiṣṇavo divyaḥ śaraḥ para puraṁjayaḥ ।moghaḥ patati vīryeṇa bala darpa vināśanaḥ ॥1-76-8॥

translations.english: On conquering the hostile cities and destroying the pride and strength of the enemy by its prowess, this celestial arrow of Visnu shall not go in vain".
